criteria.silhouette_scale: A continuous liquid material with low-contrast folds and sparse glints that survive the 64-pixel reduction.
criteria.implementable_geometry: Uses the existing Minecraft fluid surface and side geometry, so no custom mesh is required.
criteria.mechanics_clearance: No mesh or mechanical parts; fluid heights remain controlled by block states.
criteria.period_materials: Crude reads as near-black petroleum; the photographic material reference guides color and reflections only, with no copied watermark.
criteria.family_consistency: The quiet dark oil contrasts with the timber Oil Derrick and iron refinery without amber glow or ornament.
criteria.controls_readability: There are no controls on this material texture.
criteria.gameplay_scope: The graphic adds no acquisition or resource simulation rules.

criteria.matches_direction: The 64-pixel reduction preserves a near-black body, subtle umber depth and broken cool highlights without luminous ribbons.
criteria.geometry_uvs: One periodic 64-pixel fluid face with eight 64-pixel animation frames; built-in fluid geometry supplies levels and edges.
criteria.material_consistency: The same atlas is used by surface and reservoir crude fluid states.
criteria.assembly_interfaces: Liquid renderer uses the registered still and flowing atlas; no separate model interfaces.
criteria.animation_states: A looping eight-frame subpixel warp changes the eddies slowly without a hard cycle reset.
criteria.native_size_readability: Quiet forms remain legible in the four-tile preview at native resolution, with much lower overall brightness than the prior atlas.

criteria.photon_materials: Daylit seep renders as near-black viscous oil with restrained brown depth; low-light reservoir appears almost black, consistent with the supplied material reference.
criteria.scale_readability: At scene scale the surface has subtle movement but no luminous amber ribbons or bright tiled grid; underground pool edge remains distinct against stone.
criteria.states_motion: A natural generated source was asserted, a controlled surface source flowed, and reservoir oil stayed finite during extraction. The eight atlas poses form a smooth loop in the frame contact sheet; live animation cadence was not captured on video.
criteria.interaction_guides: The visual fixture verified the natural center source and the derrick's physical depletion; no new interaction guide is attached to oil.
criteria.inventory_appearance: Crude has no placeable inventory item, so there is no item icon to review.
criteria.integration_limits: The controlled surface pool and exposed reservoir are visual fixtures; this review does not cover every terrain slope or live motion cadence.
